## Expertise

- Keyword research, search-intent clustering and page-level keyword mapping
- Link building: prospect qualification, personalised outreach, follow-up, anchor strategy and link tracking
- On-page optimisation: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, schema markup
- Technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, canonicals, redirects, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals basics
- SEO reporting and analytics with Google Search Console, GA4 and Looker Studio
- Web research, data entry, list building and structured data work

## Tools

Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, Google Sheets, WordPress, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Canva.

## Working approach

1. Audit and record a baseline (indexation, rankings, traffic, backlinks).
2. Prioritise a short list of changes by effort versus likely impact.
3. Ship the work: keyword maps, page fixes, outreach, tracking.
4. Report monthly on what moved, what did not, and the next decision.
